value.rationale: The number of connected components of the ordinary generalized divisor image is a natural exact topological invariant central to Sanna’s theorem and Zubrilina’s component growth study. The unreported integer exponent four has 140 components, involving 192 rational intervals and 139 strict gaps. Determining all endpoints is a complete, mathematically motivated exact classification; the answer is not provided by the general existence theorem or its three-component exponent-two example. The result does not claim an arbitrary-exponent formula or a density theorem.
